label: C · Senior data and machine learning (Python)
cvText:
Senior data scientist and machine learning engineer with 8 years of experience.

Skills: Python, SQL, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, AWS (S3, SageMaker, Lambda), MLflow, Docker, experiment design and A/B testing.

Experience: designed and deployed recommendation and demand forecasting models serving millions of users; built the MLOps pipeline for training, monitoring and retraining; led a team of four data scientists.

Languages: Spanish (native), English (C2).

Looking for a senior or staff remote role in machine learning or data science.
